text:
Alex: flagged by vuln-scan: pod in `tenant-x` called keystore decrypt for key in `tenant-y`
Priya: details? how did scan detect it?
Alex: agent audit showed TCP to /var/run/keystore.sock from pod with hostPath mounts
Sam: oh no. onprem agent binds host socket for keystore-proxy. if hostPath is writable pods can reach it
Luca: check CSI mounts and any privileged pods. also enumerate pods with hostPath: `kubectl get pods -A -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select(.spec.volumes[]? | .hostPath) | .metadata.namespace + "/" + .metadata.name'`
Maria: immediate mitigation suggestions: 1) cordon/evict suspect pods, 2) remove hostPath mounts via rollout, 3) apply networkpolicy to block access to node-local endpoints
Jamal: admission quickfix: deny new pods with hostPath to keystore path using OPA gatekeeper constraint. longer-term: prevent hostPath in tenant namespaces by PodSecurityPolicy/PSA enforcement
Priya: key actions: rotate affected keys, freeze access logs, increase decrypt log retention for that customer to 120d during investigation
Alex: sample netpol to block nodePort/socket access I tested: ```apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: block-node-access-to-keystore
  namespace: tenant-x
spec:
  podSelector: {}
  policyTypes:
  - Egress
  egress:
  - to:
    - ipBlock:
        cidr: 10.0.0.0/16
      except:
      - 10.0.5.0/24 # allow only infra subnet
```
Sam: also check for projected SA tokens: `kubectl get pods -A -o jsonpath="{range .items[*]}{.metadata.namespace} {.metadata.name} {.spec.serviceAccountName} {.spec.containers[*].securityContext}\n"`
Luca: admission rule: reject ClusterRoleBinding where subject.kind==ServiceAccount and subject.namespace!=bindingNamespace. We can push a kube-audit rule to alert now
Maria: customer comms: proactive notification template drafted. we should say what we did and that we're investigating; avoid claiming data loss until confirmed
Priya: raising INC-2026-KEystore with labels [onprem,kms,investigation] and assigning followups: Sam hostpath sweep, Luca admission policy, Alex key rotation + logs, Jamal gatekeeper changes, Maria customer comms
deploy-bot: Incident INC-2026-KEystore created by Priya
